meaning: Madhav's own trades, in his words, so Ananta can learn how he reads the market. Prices are what he paid on NDAX (CAD). The rebuild (src/research/casebook.py) pins each buy to the candles and checks every reason against the data, point in time. Evidence class USER_MARK: a person's decision and reasons, never proof a read works (that is the repair shop's job).

his_reasons: Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana were low and collapsing
Bought at the lowest as I saw it, after comparing support areas and resistance zones and how strong they are
The market had been bad for quite some time; the bear felt like it was weakening
The coin itself is valuable, so a flexible stop loss to hold through noise
cases.context_he_gave: Ethereum was about 2150 CAD at the time

his_reasons: Same read as C1: low after a long fall, at support he trusted, bear weakening, no fresh bad news, near the 52-week low
Added right after C2 (he said June 26th, or the 25th)
cases.date_note: He was not sure between June 25 and 26

his_reasons: After the June buys SOL ran up to about 115-117 CAD, then came back to 108-105
It stopped going lower and stayed stuck there: a saturation phase where the market waits for a breakout
A base like that breaks one way or the other; from the surroundings, the coin's worth and its history he judged it would break up
Plan for being wrong: if it broke down, sell this lot and keep the lots bought at 87 and 91
Mixing technicals with fundamentals; stop loss beyond a safe point

lessons.what: Bought Yes Bank (India) as a newbie while it was collapsing on bad news
lessons.lesson: Before buying, a quick point-in-time AI check of the news, to catch bad news about the asset itself that the chart reading missed
lessons.rule_he_uses: Use AI as a last look for blunders, not as the reason to buy
